en: %s reads Sully's letter page by page.
I don't train your kind $c.  Find your own trainer before you anger me.
Shut inside this little house, I dream of joining the battles that rage outside the city walls. Still, duty compels me to share my knowledge with others who fight in my stead... for now.
Intruders!  The Hammer shall fall upon you.
Looks like we've uncovered this $n. Now help me kill it!
Click here to remove res effects and repair all gear
You have truly excelled in your knowledge of enchanting. There is much more to learn, if you are willing. Speak to Taladan, in the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus.
Ah, let me see. Yes probably nearing a hundred times now I'd wager!
Be bathed in the power of the Warchief! Drink in his might! Battle for the glory of the Horde!
Unfortunately you are not yet strong enough to survive in Warsong Gulch, $c.
You seek Kardris Dreamseeker.  She and the other shaman are in the entrance room to Thrall's Fortress in the Valley of Wisdom.
I would like to check my deposit box.
You have disturbed my rest, $c.  Now face my wrath!
There is something you wish to discuss, $c... come, sit by me.
Kahil, it was a mighty effort. Come back and rest up. Narrisha will clean this up for us.

Greetings, $c.  It is the time of the Harvest Festival - a time of great bounties and a time of remembrance.  We partake of feasts to celebrate all we have to be thankful of, and we remember our ancestors and past heroes to give thanks to the legacy they gave us.$B$BPlease feel free to partake of the feast being offered here.  Also, I am offering some fireworks to help celebrate this joyous time of year.
Take that, beast!
Tailoring can come in very handy. I once had to sew my arm back on.
I promise you this much: The Valley will be ours.
The Dark Irons thought these tablets to be encoded. This is not any form of coding, it is the tongue of ancient dragon.
Assassins... save... th... Magistraaa...
How do I use the cannon?
With all of the fighting we do of course we have a First Aid Trainer in Razor Hill.  Find Rawrk inside the barracks on the east side of town.
Greetings, $n. May Elune's wisdom guide your hand and heart. How may I help you today?
Greetings, citizen. I ask that you move along if you have nothing to ask of me.
Enjoy the rest of your stay in Menethil. It won't last much longer.
How could this happen?
Brains...
Ah, well aren't you a sturdy-looking one? Perhaps you can assist me with a thing or two. Not much help around here except for green apprentices, and they've other things to worry about.
I have about half the supplies needed to upgrade to veteran units.
%s lets loose a massive attack.
Thuwd will show you how to skin your kills.  Look for him at Kodohide Leatherworkers in The Drag.

Rend, son of Blackhand: Impotent chieftain of the Blackrock clan. A more stubborn bastard does not exist.$B$BAt the end of the second War, Rend and his brother, Maim, fled to find sanctuary within the mountainous stronghold of Blackrock Spire. It was there that Rend declared himself Warchief of the weakened Blackrock clan.
30 seconds until the battle for Alterac Valley begins.
%s holds the Rune of Escape in front of her.
You are an exceptional enchanter. Beyond my talents as a teacher, I fear. Seek out Kitta Firewind at the Tower of Azora. Only she can qualify as your instructor now.
OZZIE!!!! OH NO!
I smell a $R
The people in Nighthaven sure know how to party!
The heathens will be forced to react. Orcs, bull-men...
Oh... I'm feeling faint...
I've been better.  Ivar the Foul got the better of me...
